findings.classification: source-level safeguard and conditional question; not a new independent defect
findings.evidence: Native derive dispatch has separate struct, tuple-struct, enum and opaque paths; opaque chooses impl_opaque and auto-FromReflect only when metadata permits. The opaque generator downcasts the existing Self and Clone-clones it; its remote branch instead downcasts the declared remote type, clones it, and invokes into_wrapper. Opaque apply replaces the whole value after an exact successful downcast; on a mismatch it returns a typed error without performing that replacement. These source branches do not independently construct arbitrary raw scalar fields; they also do not validate or repair any typed value that was invalid before cloning.
findings.current_owner: 95e PositiveLength declares a private f32, finite strictly-positive from_metres and manual Deserialize routed through that constructor. When its optional reflect feature is enabled, source requests derive(Reflect) and reflect(opaque). SignedLength and Area each retain distinct finite/signed and finite/nonnegative constructor and Serde bounds; zero remains valid for those respective domains. The geometry manifest defaults to no features and declares reflect as an optional Bevy dependency.
findings.conditions: The dispatch conclusion is conditional on actual derive metadata selecting the opaque branch and enabling its auto-FromReflect; no expansion or active Cargo feature graph was established. No actual reflection, Deserialize dispatcher, invalid-value construction, or caller was executed or proved. Other construction and mutation paths, user-provided Clone semantics in other types, remote wrappers and native framework helpers outside displayed scopes remain open.
findings.future_direction: Keep checked owners and their distinct bounds; identify actual enabled 95e target/features, reflective FromReflect/apply/Deserialize callers, and every supported owner ingress before deciding whether a repair is needed. Do not count cloning itself as an admission bypass or erase signed/zero-valid roles.
